title: Go Forth With the Voice of Destiny!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Epiphaneia to defeat Symboli Kris S—
the very first skill she must master is
'holding back during the run.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In their previous showdown,
she ran completely wild without pacing
herself at all,
leaving nothing in the tank for the final
stretch and losing by a wide margin.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight!
Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...!
I'm exhausted—!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry!
But the voice of destiny told me to push
harder!
Thanks to that, I went crazy fast,
right? Wasn't I amazing?!
choice_data_list: I mean, you were fast, but still!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How many times had this happened already?
With Epiphaneia completely
unable to hold back and running rampant...
I was starting to resent that voice of
destiny.
choice_data_list: Hey, is there any chance that voic...
Hey, is there any chance that voic...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Nope!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Wait,
do you not want me listening to the voice
of destiny?
Why's that?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, then hearing it is way better!
Whenever this voice gives the green light,
it always leads to the right outcome!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia's faith in the voice of destiny
was unshakable. If so...
coaching her might be easier if I try to
understand the true nature of that voice.
choice_data_list: I wonder if I could hear that voic...
I wonder if I could hear that voic...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa,
whoa!
Nobody's ever said that to me before!
That's awesome! Let's do it,
let's try! Come with me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that moment on—
everything moved at a breakneck pace.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You heard that just now, right,
Trainer?!
Let's take photos,
dive into the purikura booth!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Look,
'1 Million Visitors Promo:
Super Glam Filter Free'!
Awesome,
you look super cute in these stickers!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—No, this dirt path over here is better!
The voice of destiny says so too!!
Wooohooo!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...
taking this path was totally the right
call!
Trainer, look! —Lift your head up!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—See, what a view!
You can see so faaaar into the distance... Wow,
this is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
after being dragged around all over the
place—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, it's getting cloudy... but we'll be fine.
...So, how was it!
You heard it too,
right? The voice of destiny!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see!
But you understand how wonderful the voice
of destiny is now, right?
Wherever that voice pushes you to go,
only good things happen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...To be fair, everywhere the voice guided us,
good fortune followed.
I was too exhausted to enjoy it,
but the end results—were all positive.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I can remember,
it's always been like that!
Whenever I followed where the voice cheered
me on, good things happened without fail.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And yet—nobody else can hear it.
Don't you think that's such a waste?
choice_data_list: So... you want to share that voice...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
If everyone can feel my 'destiny,' they'll
be able to hear it too.
Everyone can get that push forward from the
voice! —Isn't that awesome?!
choice_data_list: You really believe... that it's bo...
You really believe... that it's bo...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Because I'm—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Beloved by destiny!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that exact moment.
The instant those words left her lips—
the clouds parted,
revealing a sky so densely packed with stars
it filled our entire field of vision.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It cleared up after all!
—Trainer,
here's a present from me. Take it!
choice_data_list: Huh? A present... this night sky?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Since you wanted to hear the voice of
destiny—
and took the first step toward my dream with
me, I'm giving you a whole sky of stars.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Once my dream comes true,
you'll see an even more glittering world.
—I'm gonna fill your eyes with it,
just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia never doubted herself,
holding unwavering faith in a brilliant
future. Perhaps influenced by her—
a sense of certainty began to kindle within
me as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia will surely... no, without a doubt,
achieve something incredible.
I didn't know what that might be.
But—my heart was already pounding with
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kris S!! What,
were you the one waiting for me?!
So—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
A test.
That trainer is testing themselves.
If they are not up to the task—
they will no longer be your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Whether you change or not.
Whether you leave them behind...
is up to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I came to understand Epiphaneia much more
deeply, but in the end...
I never did hear the voice of destiny.
There was no time left before the race to
figure out another plan...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —You'll shout, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I'll give you the signal whe...
Yeah. I'll give you the signal whe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The voice of destiny cannot be controlled.
If so—perhaps by
drowning it out with an even louder roar...
I could conquer it.
choice_data_list: (It's pure brute force, I know, bu...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia is already in peak condition for
who she is right now.
If we have any chance at victory—
it lies in catching our breath and making
the right move.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Are you really sure about this, though?
I won't pull punches.
When I hear the voice of destiny—
I won't stop.
choice_data_list: I know. But let me try anyway.
I know. But let me try anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If what Epiphaneia hears is my voice instead
of the voice of destiny—
then I can truly hold my head high as her
Trainer.
choice_data_list: Let's take on your voice of destiny!
Let's take on your voice of destiny!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Now that's what I'm talking about!
—Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia breaks out with fantastic momentum.
Has she not
heard the voice of destiny yet...?
She's running in great form.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh?!
...Voice,
are you still not there? Not yet...—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! ...I get it!
In that case—let's charge together!
UOOOOOOOOOOHHHH...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia saw the race through without
running wild. When the moment came,
she responded perfectly...—
My voice reached her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so—we suffered defeat.
Symboli Kris S was simply on an entirely
different level...
choice_data_list: (I couldn't lead her to victory. D...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――A shift.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
You were defeated. Yet—you brought change.
Go—...achieve your result.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—It overlapped completely with the voice of
destiny.
Your shout... yelling, "NOW!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I thought there was only one voice like that
out there. But...
I was wrong.
Your voice pushed me forward too...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I knew it—you really ARE my destiny...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I'm gonna lead you to the greatest victory
ever!
So don't hesitate anymore!
Just believe in me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that instant,
every shadow of doubt cleared away.
In my heart,
a single wish shone bright like a star—
to witness Epiphaneia's future—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Come on, listen to my voice!
Until the day destiny fills the whole world—
you'll come with me, won't you?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Come on, listen to my voice!
Until the day destiny fills the whole world—
you'll come with me, won't you?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How will that star shine,
and what will it achieve?
I don't know just yet.
But where that light leads—
is undoubtedly the right path.
